newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Meralco unit signs power distribution pact.
newsitem.headline: Meralco unit signs power distribution pact.

text.p: A unit of the Manila Electric Co (Meralco) has signed a joint venture agreement to undertake power distribution at the Clark special economic zone in the northern Pampanga province, state-agency Clark Development Corp said on Thursday.

In a statement, Clark Development said it will form with the Meralco Industrial Engineering Services Corp (Miescor) a joint venture company to be called Clark Electric Distribution Corporation for the project.
The joint venture firm will upgrade the existing power distribution system at the economic zone, the statement said.
